best_for: Windows users who take screenshots for bug reports, docs or support tickets and want to mark them up and send them on in a few clicks, at no cost.

points.title: Free and open source on Windows
points.text: The Windows version is free and open source under the GPL, with no paid tier. It is a light tool that does one job: take a screenshot, mark it up, and pass it on.

points.title: Sends straight to your tools
points.text: Screenshots can go straight to Jira Server or Jira Cloud, through an OCR plugin, or to any other program you set up as an external command. That saves a save-then-attach step on every ticket.

points.title: Windows 10 or later
points.text: Versions of Windows before Windows 10 are no longer supported, and Greenshot 1.3 needs .NET Framework 4.7.2 or newer. If you are stuck on an older Windows, you need an older release.

points.title: The Mac version costs USD 1.99
points.text: A separate Mac version is sold on the Mac App Store for USD 1.99, which the project says helps cover its costs. It is not part of this listing. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Per-user or machine-wide
points.text: The Windows installer is a 32-bit build offered for the current user, with no administrator rights needed, or for all users. A zip version is also published.

points.title: Older releases
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 12 versions. The latest, 1.3.328, came out in October 2026.
